run_annotation_tool_1: run the annotation tool to render an MTurk HTML page for Minecraft command annotation
render_css_script: render the CSS_SCRIPT template that hides up to 40 words by index for annotation highlighting
render_before_template: render the BEFORE HTML template with Bootstrap styling and annotation instructions for MTurk workers
render_after_template: render the AFTER HTML template that closes the annotation page with tooltip styles and scripts
render_questions_with_render_q: render annotation questions using render_questions_tool_1.render_q for action and action loop question types
